faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.body: The short version of what people ask before they start clipping.

sources.question: What videos can I clip?
sources.answer: YouTube videos, Twitch and Kick VODs or clips, and files you upload yourself. Paste a link or drag in a recording, and SupoClip takes it from there.

selection.question: How does SupoClip choose the clips?
selection.answer: It transcribes the video word by word, then an AI model reads the whole transcript and picks moments that stand on their own. Each one is scored for hook, engagement, value, and shareability, and you can trim, split, or merge any clip afterwards.

minutes.question: How are minutes counted?
minutes.answer: Plans are measured in minutes of source video, not in clips. Pro includes {proHours} hours a month and Creator {creatorHours} hours. A 30-minute video uses 30 minutes, however many clips come out of it. Allowances reset every month, on yearly plans too.

publishing.question: Can SupoClip post to TikTok and Instagram?
publishing.answer: Today you can publish straight to YouTube Shorts: right away on Pro, or on a schedule with Creator. TikTok and Instagram are coming soon. Until then, download clips with the TikTok and Reels export presets and upload them yourself.

watermark.question: Do clips have a watermark?
watermark.answer: No. SupoClip never adds a watermark, on hosted plans or when you self-host.

languages.question: Does it work in other languages?
languages.answer: Yes. The spoken language is detected automatically, so transcripts, captions, and clip picks follow the language of the video.

selfHost.question: Is it really free to self-host?
selfHost.answer: Yes. SupoClip is open source under AGPL-3.0 and runs with Docker Compose on your own machine. You only pay for the transcription and AI providers you choose, if any.

cancel.question: Can I cancel anytime?
cancel.answer: Yes. Change or cancel your plan from settings whenever you like. If you subscribed in the iPhone app, manage it through the App Store.
